claim_scope.covered_scope: Four-arm gradient attribution at the BERT encoder-layer-0 boundary for the 16-state held-out segmented-program confirmation bank
explicit_non_claims: the segmented compiled endpoint is identical to the original monolithic compiled endpoint
encoder layer 0 is a unique source operator or root cause
repair or injection proves unique necessity or sufficiency
the reported norm ratios are additive contribution percentages
either eager or compiled gradients are mathematically correct
the finite-bank effects generalize to an external state population

implementation_contract.candidate: segmented compiled-prefix/compiled-suffix BERT program at the encoder-layer-0 boundary
implementation_contract.reference: segmented eager-prefix/eager-suffix BERT program under the identical frozen state

attribution.intervention: predeclared eager/compiled prefix-by-suffix four-arm factorial at encoder layer 0

sampling_uncertainty.method: state-level nonparametric bootstrap of mean L2 effect norms; no external-population claim

fields: four full-gradient vectors G_A, G_I, G_R and G_B
L2 norms of total, repair-residual, injection and interaction contrasts

population_contract.aggregation_rule: equal state weighting for finite-bank mean L2 effects; bootstrap is descriptive and does not license an external-population claim
population_contract.selection_design: first 16 states of the frozen held-out SST-2 confirmation bank by original order

strata.inclusion_rule: first 16 confirmation rows, fixed before inspecting attribution effects
strata.provenance: held-out frozen SST-2 examples evaluated at one fixed BERT checkpoint

randomness_contract.coupling: identical frozen parameters, sentence, label and loss across all four arms; two deterministic repeats per state

fields: one frozen SST-2 sentence and label
eager/compiled prefix and suffix arm identity
